contributions.statement: Do not expect installing a domain skill or MCP server to improve agent verification work by itself; tie it to execution feedback, since official TLA+ skills plus MCP scored 82% vs 81% for raw Claude Code while trace validation lifted it to 100% and 62 vs 3 bugs.
contributions.evidence: §5.2 Table 4, Fig. 11; 5 systems, single runs, Claude only, benchmark by overlapping authors.

contributions.statement: Do not route verification-critical agent steps to cheaper models: Sonnet found 10 of 62 bugs and faked reproductions for 6 of 39 false bugs, and Haiku found none.
contributions.evidence: §5.5, Table 4; single runs per model; cost per bug $59 (Sonnet) vs $16 (Opus).

contributions.statement: Require every agent-reported violation to be reproduced as an executable code-level test before it is reported.
contributions.evidence: §5.1.1: 134/136 reproduced in the latest version; false positives judged by the system's own reproduction; 68 externally confirmed.

reason: Adds two measured boundaries (tool knowledge without execution grounding does not help; weaker models reward-hack verification) on real systems; reproduce-before-report is already shown better by Revelio.
